therapeutics_text: > MEZEREUM. Pains in the long bones, especially tibia. Facial neuralgia or toothache, when the pains are greatly < by eating or motions of the jaws, > by radiate heat. Nose; vesicular eruptions, with excoriations, formation of thick scabs, < at night; zona. * * * * * Pains in the long bones , especially the tibia are sometimes greatly relieved by this remedy. I once cured a very obstinate case of facial neuralgia with it. The pains were brought on, or greatly aggravated, by eating , and the only relief he could get was to hold that side of his face as near as he could to a hot stove. Hot cloths, wet or dry, or any other heat applied did not relieve. Zona . Skin diseases, etc. See Materia Medica.
